title: Stewardship
definition: Stewardship is the faithful management of all God has entrusted to a person, including time, gifts, resources, body, opportunities, and relationships.
summary: Everything belongs to God. Believers are called to use what they have for His glory and the good of others.
christFocus: Christ gave Himself fully for the Father's will, showing the heart of faithful stewardship.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Everything belongs to God. Believers are called to use what they have for His glory and the good of others.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
